s25_12:30.flag: Ambiguous key (B). The graph of liver glycogen falls in both period B (from the peak back to the normal level) and period C (from normal to below normal); in both, glycogen is being broken down, which is the action of adrenaline. Using the logic of the similar item w23_12:27 (glycogen rising = blood glucose above average), blood glucose would be moving up towards its set point in both B and C. Key B has been recorded as given; option C cannot be excluded from the information printed. Notes record only the general rule (falling liver glycogen = glycogen being converted to glucose).
